findings.title: Preserve the light-theme color for embedded-post author links
findings.body: The light-theme branch changes the embedded-post author link from 30% lightness scaling to 70%, although this change is intended to fix dark themes. With a black primary color, this changes the link from approximately #4d4d4d to #b3b3b3, substantially reducing its contrast and making the author attribution harder to read. Keep the original 30% light-theme value and use the complementary 70% secondary scaling for the dark-theme branch.

findings.title: Keep mobile topic-map headings distinct from secondary labels
findings.body: The new light-theme branch changes topic-map h3 headings from 20% to 50% lightness scaling, making them lighter even on existing light themes. It also gives h3 headings exactly the same color as the h4 secondary labels immediately below them, removing the existing visual hierarchy and reducing heading contrast. Preserve the original 20% primary scaling and use 80% secondary scaling for dark themes, as the desktop topic-map h3 rule does.
